# Streamer.bot Display Commands for Spicetify Remote

```

```

To use the import: open Streamer.bot → _Actions_ tab → right-click → _Import_ → paste the code → _Import_. Set up your chat triggers (`!song`, `!np`) on the action.

> **Note:** This import is configured for **Twitch** only. If you use a different platform, set up the action manually from the template below.

## Setup

No C# code or WebSocket setup needed. Each command uses native Streamer.bot sub-actions:

| #   | Sub-action       | Settings                                                                                                                                                    |
| --- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | **HTTP Request** | Method: `GET`, URL: `http://localhost:8888/api/state`, Variable: `stateJson` _(auto-parses JSON into `%stateJson.spotify.X%` / `%stateJson.soundcloud.X%`)_ |
| 2   | **Logic / If**   | Conditional branches to detect which source is active                                                                                                       |
| 3   | **Send Message** | Chat response using the parsed variables                                                                                                                    |

> Port `8888` is the default — adjust if your `data/config.json` overrides it.

## Available Variables

### Spotify (`%stateJson.spotify.*`)

| Variable                           | Type   | Example                                 |
| ---------------------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------- |
| `%stateJson.spotify.trackName%`    | string | "Poker Face"                            |
| `%stateJson.spotify.artistName%`   | string | "Lady Gaga"                             |
| `%stateJson.spotify.albumName%`    | string | "The Fame"                              |
| `%stateJson.spotify.trackUri%`     | string | `spotify:track:...`                     |
| `%stateJson.spotify.albumArtUrl%`  | string | `https://i.scdn.co/...`                 |
| `%stateJson.spotify.volume%`       | string | "0.5"                                   |
| `%stateJson.spotify.isPlaying%`    | string | "True" / "False"                        |
| `%stateJson.spotify.isShuffling%`  | string | "True" / "False"                        |
| `%stateJson.spotify.repeatStatus%` | string | "0" (off) / "1" (context) / "2" (track) |
| `%stateJson.spotify.isLiked%`      | string | "True" / "False"                        |
| `%stateJson.spotify.progress%`     | string | "190817" (ms)                           |
| `%stateJson.spotify.duration%`     | string | "237200" (ms)                           |
| `%stateJson.spotify.progressFmt%`  | string | "3:10"                                  |
| `%stateJson.spotify.durationFmt%`  | string | "3:57"                                  |

| Variable                             | Type   | Example          |
| ------------------------------------ | ------ | ---------------- |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.track%`       | string | "Song Title"     |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.artist%`      | string | "Artist Name"    |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.album%`       | string | "Album Name"     |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.coverUrl%`    | string | `https://...`    |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.volume%`      | string | "0.5"            |

| `%stateJson.soundcloud.isLiked%`     | string | "True" / "False" |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.progressMs%`  | string | "120000" (ms)    |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.durationMs%`  | string | "240000" (ms)    |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.progressFmt%` | string | "2:00"           |
| `%stateJson.soundcloud.durationFmt%` | string | "4:00"           |

## Command Templates

### `!song` / `!np` — Now Playing

Both triggers run the same action. Set both as triggers in Streamer.bot.

| #   | Sub-action                           | Settings                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | **HTTP Request**                     | `GET http://localhost:8888/api/state` → Variable: `stateJson`                                                                                                              |
| 2   | **Logic — If/Else**                  | If `%stateJson.spotify.isPlaying%` equals `"True"`                                                                                                                         |
|     | → **True**                           | **Send Message:** `[Spotify] "%stateJson.spotify.trackName%" by %stateJson.spotify.artistName% [%stateJson.spotify.progressFmt% / %stateJson.spotify.durationFmt%]`        |
|     | → **False**                          | _(add another Logic sub-action inside the False branch)_                                                                                                                   |
| 3   | **Logic — If/Else** _(inside False)_ | If `%stateJson.soundcloud.isPlaying%` equals `"True"`                                                                                                                      |
|     | → **True**                           | **Send Message:** `[SoundCloud] "%stateJson.soundcloud.track%" by %stateJson.soundcloud.artist% [%stateJson.soundcloud.progressFmt% / %stateJson.soundcloud.durationFmt%]` |
|     | → **False**                          | **Send Message:** `Nothing is playing at the moment.`                                                                                                                      |
